storage_allocation_policy.notes: User clarified that the 4TB-class HDD may be used for up to about 3.8 decimal TB of worthwhile archive. This does not waive the independently checked free-space floor. If formatted volume cannot satisfy both, actual allowed archive bytes will be smaller; do not invent capacity.

user_reported_capacity.reported_text: about 3.8 TB displayed/usable on a purchased 4 TB-class HDD
user_reported_capacity.unit_and_meaning: not independently verified; TB vs TiB, total vs free, and exact bytes unknown

inference_operational_cost_policy.priority: Co-primary with archival distinctiveness and measured practicality; high-risk forecast does not override authorization

total_parameter_policy.compare_field: actual total learned parameters including inactive MoE experts, embedding, MTP; quantization does NOT reduce count
total_parameter_policy.under_baseline: passes size screening only; all separate legal/storage/runtime/manifest gates still mandatory
total_parameter_policy.at_or_over_baseline: allow a named exact quantized model variant to be investigated, but keep HOLD/blocked until verified runtime, quality, rights, revision and approval; never allow unquantized source implicitly
total_parameter_policy.memory_measurement: Complete observed peak including model weights, OS/runtime, KV, image/audio encoders, draft, staging needed for inference; document RAM/VRAM and whether sum double counts shared unified memory
total_parameter_policy.performance_validation: Report fixed hardware, backend version, quant implementation/zero-point, context, batch, ≥30 representative trials, median throughput/latency and task quality vs original and competitive alternatives. User-defined threshold required before VERIFICATION.
verified_exception_requirements: selected files and SHA256 and their total bytes
licensed access incl. gated user permission
all trained dependencies and their count/rights
measured complete peak inference memory <512GB decimal
actual quality pass and useful speed at fixed hardware/context/batch
total_parameter_policy.previous_policy: v8-v11 >=150B hard exclusion is HISTORICAL and superseded; no exception granted solely by this revision
